lesson: Postgres JSONB normalizes object key order and drops undefined; any equality check against persisted state (JSON.stringify ===) silently fails in prod while structuredClone-based fakes keep it green. Compare with util.isDeepStrictEqual and make repository fakes persist through a JSONB-faithful round trip (see test/unit/application/jsonb-round-trip.ts).
